suppress.notes: False positive (#131). CVE-2022-31691 is in Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse and the VS Code Spring extensions (Spring Boot Tools, Concourse CI Pipeline Editor, Bosh Editor, Cloudfoundry Manifest YML Support): their YAML editing uses SnakeYAML. The CPE analyzer matched spring-boot-devtools to the spring_boot_tools / spring_tools products by name. spring-boot-devtools is not one of the affected products, and the DC declares it runtime and optional, for local development only.
